div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
阶段 1: verify_order (核实身份与订单)
阶段 2: empathy_listen (情绪安抚与倾听)
阶段 3: policy_explain (基于 EcomRAG 解释规则)
阶段 4: solution_negotiate (退换/阶梯补偿协商)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 已达成 或 追问已满 2 次

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 否 (继续扮演挑剔买家对话)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 客服发送一轮回复 POST /api/v1/training/sessions/{id}/chat/stream

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
load_context 节点:
从 AsyncPostgresSaver 加载多轮状态
读取关联的 training_scenario_seed (商品痛点) 与历史摘要

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
check_stage 节点:
检查当前所处客诉实训阶段

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
evaluate_answer 节点:
1. 核对客服引用的售后规则是否符合 EcomRAG 条款
2. 检查沟通礼貌度与安抚有效性 (不误杀'抱歉'等礼貌词)
3. 判断当前阶段目标是否达成 (同一争议点最多追问 2 次)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保持当前阶段, 追问计数器 follow_up_count += 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 推进 stage 至下一阶段 (若第4阶段完成则置为 finished)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
generate_response 节点:
显式启用 get_llm('interview', streaming=True)
按当前阶段扮演挑剔买家发起质询并逐 token 流式推送

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
generate_report 节点:
汇总整场对练的规则准确度、情绪安抚力、方案合规度评分报告

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
save_report 节点:
写入 PostgreSQL training_sessions 表

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
save_memory 节点 (已修复原项目两大记忆缺陷):
1. 先将本轮 AI 回复追加进完整 messages 列表
2. 判断 len(messages) % (threshold * 2) == 0 (偶数轮精准触发摘要)
3. 无论是否触发摘要, 每轮均执行数据库 UPSERT 保存最新状态

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 本轮 SSE 流结束, 等待客服下一轮输入
